anomalies.observed: C21 is connected as a +5V-to-GND decoupling capacitor, but its schematic/SPICE value is 10 n while its footprint, library part, description, PN, and LCSC fields all identify a 10 µF 16 V X5R 0805 capacitor.
anomalies.expected: The component value should agree with the selected part metadata (10 µF), or the footprint/PN/description should be changed to a 10 nF part. A passive's reference, value, footprint, library part, and description should be mutually consistent.

evidence.quote: (comp (ref "C21") (value "10n") (footprint "Coert-Vonk:CAP X5R 10μF ±10 16V 0805 Murata GRM") ... (field (name "PN") "GRM21BR61C106KE15L") ... (description "10 µF ±10% 16V Ceramic Capacitor X5R 0805 (2012 Metric)"))

anomalies.impact: If the 10 nF value is used for assembly, the +5V rail loses the intended 10 µF bypass/bulk capacitance, increasing noise on the rail feeding the ESP32 DevKit and the AZ1117 LDO. If the 10 µF PN is used, the schematic/SPICE value is wrong and does not represent the built board.

parsed.summary: Most connectivity and values match the specification, but C21's schematic/SPICE value (10 nF) contradicts its selected component metadata (10 µF), indicating a component-value anomaly on the +5V decoupling network.
